title: Provision of Internal Elevator at Beypore Lighthouse in Kochi Dte
summary: Two-cover e-tender for providing an internal elevator (lift) in Beypore Lighthouse, Chaliyam, Kozhikode, Kerala.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

scope.item: Provision of internal elevator at Beypore Lighthouse

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to be submitted physically.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Lift manufacturing agency with valid licence/registration from State CEIG or other State/Central licensing authority and experience in fabrication/erection of structural steel lift towers and lift installation; OR registered civil contractor in joint venture consortium with a lift manufacturer
Similar works in last 7 years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost (completed works with completion certificates only)

Similar work: supply, installation, testing and commissioning of elevator; for JV: any civil engineering works (RCC tower, steel structures, multi-storeyed building, bridge, water tank) for first party plus lift manufacturer experience for second party
JV documents: legal status, registration, power of attorney for both parties; second party's CEIG manufacturing licence; a JV member may not bid individually or in another JV
PAN and GST registration; CA-certified turnover of last three years
notes: NIT Section I only; no lift specification or BOQ. Bid download/submission 21.03.2025 (15:00) to 16.04.2025 (15:00); bid query last date 27.03.2025 11:00; EMD original by 15.04.2025 15:00. Eligibility table numbers two separate items as '1)'.
